items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I mean, he was playing with Milford Dahlio... [INTERVIEWEE] I would never think of him, but...

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean, he was playing with Milford Dahlio, who's not a soft drummer.
I would never think of him, but... It was an electric, but Gale has an electric guitar, too. He has used it.
